exposure: Breastfeeding within the first hour of life
outcome: Complementary feeding (offering salt, sugar, honey, ultra-processed, processed, and in natura foods)
cohort: The study followed 352 mother-child pairs recruited from two public hospitals between 2011 and 2016.
finding: Breastfeeding within the first hour was associated with exclusive breastfeeding at two months and a lower probability of offering salt, sugar, and honey during complementary feeding.
followup_time: Between three and five years (with observations at six months and between three and five years)
